items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: the string band with Manuel Perez and this fellow, Naum Manetta

ctx.x: What's that? Johnny Gould, the first string band ever, you know, ragtime band ever heard. Then afterwards they come with the mother band, the Cucked Seeders and the string band with Manuel Perez and this fellow, Naum Manetta, one of them fellows that's in the old, that's before your time. So Naum Manetta, I bought his horn after he died. That was Manuel Manetta's uncle. Yeah, here it's been a long time. Oh yeah? Yeah, it's been a long time. I bought his horn.
Was that the first horn you ever had?

items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: Yeah, he did. Now, You take, uh, Louis played, Play, There's fifteen. Then, uh, You take Manuel and them had the coppery, Or had the economy hall. Manuel Perez.

ctx.x: Uh, Bunk used to talk about a fellow they called Mustache that ran that place. Some Italian.
